"The reaction of an Iranian TV anchor to Lindsey Graham's death, American Senator, today, July 12."

""

"TV Anchor: " Lindsey Graham, the anti-Iranian senator went to hell. Senator Graham was one of the most staunch anti-Iranian figures in the US Congress and had repeatedly supported Trump's attacks against Iran. The Lindsey Graham's office used the phrase "sudden illness" to describe the cause of death of this American senator. Inciting attacks on Iran, rejoicing in the killing of the Iranian people, and supporting the child-killing Zionist regime are among the records of this American senator. Ben-Gvir, the minister of internal security of the Zionist regime, reacting to Graham's death, said that today Israel has lost one of its greatest friends. This news is such good one that I want to read it to you one more time. Lindsey Graham, the anti-Iranian senator, went to hell.
